items.source: Constructs a new ClassTooLargeException.
items.translation: 构造一个新的ClassTooLargeException。

items.source: Exception thrown when the constant pool of a class produced by a ClassWriter is too large.
items.translation: 由ClassWriter生成的类的常量池过大时抛出异常。

items.source: Returns the internal name of the class (see Type.getInternalName()).
Returns the number of constant pool items of the class.
items.translation: 返回该类常量池中的项目数量。
